prompt:
A blank, empty trading-card frame template for a card game based on the Norse Eddas and sagas, seen perfectly flat and straight-on, filling the whole image edge to edge, portrait orientation. Layout from top to bottom: a narrow horizontal title bar across the top with a round empty medallion at its right end; below it a large rectangular art window taking up about the upper half of the card, filled with solid flat pure black (#000000) with crisp straight edges; below that a thin horizontal type bar; below that a large empty rectangular text box of pale aged parchment; at the bottom right a small empty plaque overlapping the corner of the text box. The title bar, medallion, type bar, text box and plaque are completely blank. Style: a rustic, retro 1990s hand-painted trading-card frame, gouache and ink texture, worn and weathered like an old printed card, muted colours, matte with no glossy highlights, no glow, no light rays, no sky, symmetrical with clean edges. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no logo, no watermark, and nothing inside the black window.

Legendary rarity, the grandest frame of all, fit for Odin's hall Valhalla: blazing burnished gold everywhere, the border built of golden shields like Valhalla's roof, the great spear Gungnir running down one side and the world tree Yggdrasil's golden roots and branches weaving round the rest, the two ravens and Odin's two wolves Geri and Freki in gold at the corners, a band of green and violet aurora across the top and a single glowing eye of Odin at the top centre. Warm golden light seems to shine from the frame itself. Overwhelming and divine, still hand-painted, never glossy or 3D-rendered. Norse, Viking Age: no Greek key, no laurel. The border is as thin as on an ordinary card frame, so the title bar, art window and text box stay full size; ornament keeps to the outer edges.
Near-mint condition: aged and antique, but no play wear, creases or scuffs. The wear is on the frame only; the black art window stays solid, untouched black.
